# Simulation of time harmonic acoustic propagation in an arbitrary subsonic mean flow

## Context
PhD Thesis (CERFACS / Université de Toulouse et INSA de Toulouse, 2009-2013) and master’s thesis internship at EADS Innovation Works (2009) on the 
simulation of sound radiation from a turbofan engine in a complex subsonic flow.

## Methods
- Acoustic / hydrodynamic coupling (Galbrun's equation)
- Mixed continuous-discontinuous finite elements
- Harmonic regime (frequency domain)
- Integral method / finite elements coupling (master's thesis) 

## Stack
Fortran - scientific computing librairies (CERFACS)

## Publication
Bonnet-Ben Dhia A.S. et al. 2012. Time-harmonic acoustic scattering in a complex flow. Communications in Computational Physics, 11(2), 555-572.
[https://doi.org/10.4208/cicp.221209.030111s](https://doi.org/10.4208/cicp.221209.030111s)

**Peynaud, Emilie**. 2013. “Rayonnement Sonore Dans Un Écoulement Subsonique Complexe En Régime Harmonique : Analyse Et Simulation Numérique Du Couplage Entre Les Phénomènes Acoustiques Et Hydrodynamiques.” These de doctorat, Toulouse, INSA. [https://theses.fr/2013ISAT0019](https://theses.fr/2013ISAT0019).
